column1: «Lucia, per la cerimonia hai già deciso tutto?» chiede Chiara.
column2: “Lucia, have you already decided everything for the ceremony?” asks Chiara.

column1: «No, il ricevimento sarà al bar, se mai» dice Chiara. «Costa meno.»
column2: “No, the reception will be at the bar, if anything,” says Chiara. “It costs less.”

column2: “A big promise is a difficult thing. I will invite your grandmother Anna, in my own way.”
“I got the flowers this morning,” she says.

column2: “Traditions are different, but the party is the same,” says Nadia.

column2: “I'll dance the tango at my wedding. It's my dream from when I was a girl.”

column1: «E la mia promessa?» dice Franco. «La mia promessa è una firma e un caffè.»
column2: “And my promise?” says Franco. “My promise is a signature and a coffee.”
“Thank you,” says Kevin, and he takes the tray.
“How many packages of coffee do we order?”
